==About==

Crafting a {{i|Red October}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Red October}} which can then be baked in {{i|Any Stove}} to produce a Red October. Red October is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Pumpkins and Gourds}} Food Group.
